meta.title: System fonts
meta.description: Adds system-font pickers for text, code and terminal fonts to Settings → General, with line-height and letter-spacing controls; enumerates installed Windows fonts. Size and weight of the content roles stay with the host theme; the interface font's size follows the body by default.
